title: xAppGen: LLM-driven Natural Language Programming for Agile xApp Development
abstract: arXiv:2603.18604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional RAN systems are closed and monolithic, stifling innovation. The openness and programmability enabled by Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) are envisioned to revolutionize cellular networks with control-plane applications--xApps. The development of xApps (typically by third-party developers), however, remains time-consuming and cumbersome, often requiring months of manual coding and integration, which hinders the roll-out of new functionalities in practice. To lower the barrier of xApp development for both developers and network operators, we present xAppGen, the first LLM-driven natural language programming framework for agile xApps that automates the entire xApp development pipeline. translated_title: xAppGen：基于大语言模型驱动的自然语言编程实现敏捷xApp开发
translated_abstract: 传统的RAN系统封闭且单一，扼杀了创新。开放无线接入网络（O-RAN）所提供的开放性和可编程性，有望通过控制面应用——xApps来彻底变革蜂窝网络。然而，xApps的开发（通常由第三方开发者完成）仍然耗时且繁琐，往往需要数月的手工编码和集成工作，这阻碍了新功能在实际中的落地推广。为了降低开发者和网络运营商的xApp开发门槛，我们提出了xAppGen，这是首个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自然语言编程框架，用于敏捷xApp开发，可自动化整个xApp开发流程。简而言之，xAppGen能够在几分钟内将高层用户意图转化为可快速部署的xApps，无需手工编码或测试。为此，该框架构建了一个全自动的xApp生成流水线，其集成了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个由大语言模型驱动的自然语言编程框架xAppGen，能在几分钟内自动将用户意图转化为可部署的xApp，实现xApp开发全流程自动化，大幅降低O-RAN应用开发门槛。
en_tdlr: This paper presents xAppGen, the first LLM-driven natural language programming framework that automatically converts user intents into deployable xApps within minutes, fully automating the xApp development pipeline and lowering the barrier for O-RAN application development.
